content: Your attunement might be permanent, but the Elemetal blocks that were formed certainly are a lot less clingy to their element.
They can actually be convinced to change element quite easily using the same ritual layout as the one that created them.
First up, remove the Elemetal capstones from the pillar and place a single one of them in the center of the slab ring.
Next, replace the capstones with blocks of the same element you wish to convert the Elemetal into.
For Fire, Red Nether Bricks brought from the depths of the Nether, Water requires Ice blocks of any sort.
Capstones for Air will be blocks made out of the tallest pieces of Bamboo, swaying in the wind, while Earth uses the unmoveable Obsidian.
Glowstone for the Light that brightens the world, and Sculk for the Dark deep down below.
Once all 5 capstones have been replaced, simply cast Elementize on the Elemetal block and the conversion ritual will start.
